jd.text:
K&K Talents is an international recruiting agency that has been providing technical resources in the European region since 1993. This position is with one of our clients in Saudi Arabia who is actively hiring candidates to expand their teams.

Role: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia
Employment Type: Full-time Permanent

Roles & Responsibilities:
In the role of Full Stack Developer, you will design and develop scalable enterprise web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies. You will work closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to integrate AI/GenAI services, APIs, and analytics into enterprise applications.
You will be involved across the Software Development Life Cycle, including development, integration, deployment, testing, production support, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop responsive, high-performance applications using React.js/Angular, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript.
Develop backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and microservices architecture.
Integrate applications with AI/GenAI services, vector databases, and ML outputs.
Implement secure RBAC and authorization aligned with enterprise standards.
Deploy and support applications across OpenShift/Kubernetes, Cloud, and On-Premise environments.
Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to deliver insights, recommendations, and analytics.
Support UAT, defect resolution, performance tuning, monitoring, and production support.
Maintain technical documentation including architecture, API contracts, and deployment specifications.

Required:
5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer in enterprise environments.
Strong experience with React.js and/or Angular.
Strong knowledge of .NET and Python backend development.
Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and Microservices.

Note: Applicants for employment in Saudia Arabia should possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.
